description: This file provides a function to read environment configuration variables from process.env, primarily used in a React frontend project. It exports a function 'getEnvConfig' that returns configuration details such as API URLs, WebSocket URL, environment mode, feature flags, and experiment toggles, sourced from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: getEnvConfig()
methods.description: Returns an object with environment configuration variables used in the frontend, sourcing data from process.env or default fallbacks.
